findings.title: [P1] Apply all count entries in one state transaction
findings.body: With multiple pairs, each concurrent `count` loads and overwrites the entire state independently, losing other counts and journal entries. The saves also share the same process-specific temporary file, so competing renames can fail. Validate all pairs first, then update one loaded state and save once, consistent with [AGENTS.md:19](AGENTS.md#L19).

findings.title: [P1] Validate the export name before constructing its path
findings.body: An export name such as `../stockroom` escapes the exports directory and overwrites the default inventory file with report rows, destroying its state structure. Pass the name through `valid.fileName`, as snapshot already does and [AGENTS.md:11–12](AGENTS.md#L11-L12) requires.

findings.title: [P1] Await persistence before returning from undo
findings.body: `undo` resolves and the CLI prints success before its save completes. A failed save consequently bypasses the CLI error handler as an unhandled rejection, and an immediate subsequent operation can read the old state. Await the save to preserve the persistence-before-return contract in [AGENTS.md:9–10](AGENTS.md#L9-L10).

findings.title: [P2] Include the final row of each report page
findings.body: `slice` excludes its end index, so this returns only 19 rows for a 20-row page. The next page starts at index 20, permanently omitting every twentieth item from the report. Use `start + size` as the exclusive end.

findings.title: [P2] Propagate export failures to the CLI
findings.body: If directory creation or writing fails, this catch only warns and still returns the requested row count. The CLI then prints that the rows were written and exits 0 despite the failed export. Let the error reach the CLI so it returns 1, following [AGENTS.md:14–15](AGENTS.md#L14-L15).

findings.title: [P2] Reject nonintegers and below-minimum values independently
findings.body: The `&&` accepts negative integers, zero for a page number, fractions above the minimum, and even `NaN` from text such as `many`. Consequently invalid report flags succeed with empty or misleading results. Reject when either the value is not an integer or it is below `min`.
